evidence.note: Four content blocks share the viewport at once: title, numbered step list (left), diagram card (centre), quote column of three attributed quotes (right), plus a footnote line.
The step list restates the same three stages the diagram shows (Return request, Warehouse, Refund), so the message is carried twice.
Quotes sit in a separate column outside the diagram card rather than in its free space; diagram card itself has large empty areas either side of the nodes.
At the small size the three columns run edge to edge between the margins with narrow gutters; footnote wraps to two lines beside the diagram card. No overlaps.
Empty diagram card beside the step list at step 0; generous margins and no overlap at any step.

rationale: Whitespace exists and nothing overlaps, but the slide carries title, step list, diagram, quote column and footnote together, with the step list duplicating the diagram, which is more elements than the message needs. It resembles the level-1 anchor's element set though it is spaced rather than squeezed. That fits level 2, busy.
